decision: Use JSONL (not JSON) for all memory files
reasoning: Append-only, no merge conflicts, grep-friendly, each line is independent. Scales to millions of entries without parsing overhead.
Zero config, no API key, no install. Just a URL. GET https://image.pollinations.ai/prompt/... returns PNG. ComfyUI as upgrade path for quality.

decision: Piper TTS + Whisper.cpp for voice stack
reasoning: Both run locally, both free, both fast (<200ms). No cloud dependency, no API limits. Mac Mini has enough power.

decision: All memory lives in nova/memory/ as JSONL files
reasoning: Git-tracked, version-controlled, readable by any session. Every session reads at start, writes at end. Compound intelligence.

decision: Sprint model: 1 hour hard stop, real artifacts only
reasoning: Owner is AuDHD — needs time-boxed execution with visible results. Theory and planning without output is waste. Every sprint must produce files you can see/hear/watch.
Owner should not need to run 10 commands. One script does: generate images, stitch video, update memory, git commit. Run bash nova/sprint.sh and walk away.

decision: Mac Mini is the factory, Claude Code is the architect
reasoning: Claude Code sandbox can't run Docker/FFmpeg/Ollama. Mac Mini can. Claude Code writes scripts and plans, Mac Mini executes them. Don't fight the constraint.

decision: D-ID free tier for immediate talking avatar
reasoning: Months-long Three.js avatar pipeline is R&D. D-ID gives a talking avatar from a photo in 60 seconds, free, today. Ship now, perfect later.
